verdict.rationale: Figma exposes a documented, well-specified REST API (with OpenAPI spec, changelog, scoped tokens, webhooks), a Plugin API for read/write access, and MCP server support, all confirmed live via runtime probes (REST spec repo, MCP OAuth handshake). This clearly lets AI-native users drive Figma programmatically through public, documented interfaces. missing for 10: no independent hands-on developer confirmation of REST/Plugin API reliability at scale, and openapi.json isn't hosted at the expected discovery path (404s in probe).
